item.title: The Echo at Tell Es-Sultan
item.author: techjourneyman@gmail.com (techjourneyman)
item.description:
The Echo at Tell es-Sultan

Setting: Jericho, c. 8,500 BCE. At the edge of the Jordan Valley sits Tell es-Sultan. Rising 28 feet above a ring of mud-brick homes stands the Tower of Jericho—humanity’s very first monumental watchtower.

Act I: “There Must Be Some Way Out of Here”

The night wind off the Judean desert smelled of parched earth and old wheat chaff. In the shadow of Jericho’s newly raised stone wall, two men huddled beside a dying hearth.

item.title: The Red Eagle of Leipzig
item.author: techjourneyman@gmail.com (techjourneyman)
item.description:
The Red Eagle of Leipzig

Kofi adjusted the lapels of his nylon parka as the 7:15 AM high-speed maglev train glided quietly into Leipzig’s Central Terminal. It was October 1992. Sixty years after the National Socialist Workers’ Party consolidated power and nationalized the nation’s industries, Germany had transformed into an economic titan. By taking back its pre-war territories without triggering a global conflict, the State had spent decades refining its ideology—merging strict state-led socialism with controlled capitalist enterprise.
